proband_anchor: Acts downstream of WWOX loss — genotype-agnostic; works even with both alleles impaired

mechanism: Restoring WWOX expression rescued cortical/molecular CNS abnormalities in patient-derived WOREE brain organoids
proband_anchor: Validates that restoring WWOX reverses the WOREE cellular phenotype

mechanism: GABA-transaminase inhibitor; controlled infantile spasms in a WOREE patient
proband_anchor: Directly protects the developmental window NOW; standard-of-care lever

mechanism: 31-aa zinc-finger-like peptide; strengthens WWOX partner binding, restored memory & reduced neuroinflammation in AD mice
proband_anchor: Could stabilize residual Q230P protein function — but only AD/cancer data, no epilepsy

mechanism: WWOX loss → GSK3β/JNK/ERK-driven Tau hyperphosphorylation & aggregation; kinase inhibitors block it in vitro
proband_anchor: Same downstream axis as lithium; multiple druggable nodes

mechanism: c.1057-2A>G disrupts the exon-9 acceptor; a splice-switching ASO could restore correct splicing (Milasen precedent)
proband_anchor: Mechanism-matched to the splice-null allele specifically

proband_anchor: Best animal model to test repurposed drugs on a HYPOMORPHIC allele like Q230P

proband_anchor: Downstream pathway; MYC/Wnt implicated in organoid rescue
